title: Lazygit — Terminal Git UI
description: Visual git operations from the terminal — stage, commit, rebase, resolve conflicts, and cherry-pick with ease.

entries.label: Launch
entries.description: Open lazygit in the current git repository

entries.label: Stage File/Hunk
entries.description: Toggle staging for a file or individual hunk — granular control

entries.label: Commit
entries.description: Open commit dialog, type message, and confirm

entries.label: Amend Commit
entries.description: Amend the last commit with current staged changes

entries.label: Push
entries.description: Push to remote — shows confirmation before pushing

entries.label: Pull
entries.description: Pull changes from remote with merge strategy

entries.label: Interactive Rebase
entries.description: Start interactive rebase from selected commit — squash, edit, reorder

entries.label: Resolve Conflict
entries.description: Visual conflict resolution — pick which side to keep

entries.label: Cherry-Pick
entries.description: Copy a commit and apply it to the current branch
